<br>

**Call for Information on Whale Killing Methods and Welfare Issues**

</center>

<br>

This Circular invites Contracting Governments to submit information on whale killing and welfare statistics for the **`r lubridate::year(Sys.Date()) - 1`** season to the Secretariat by **`r format(Sys.Date()+30, "%d %B %Y")`**.

<br>

All data received are compiled by the Secretariat and made available to the meetings of the Working Group on Whale Killing Methods and Welfare Issues (WKM-WI Working Group).

<br>

The Secretariat has developed a Summary Reporting Form, which Contracting Governments may wish to use to guide their responses (Annex 1) available [here](https://archive.iwc.int/?r=22530). Completion of this form is not compulsory nor is it intended to replace the submission of detailed reports where appropriate. The form is based upon relevant Commission Resolutions (1997-1, 1999-1, 2001-2, and 2004-3) and the revised action plan on whale killing methods developed at an IWC workshop in 2003.

<br>

Contracting Governments may also wish to use the form to provide information on times to death and methods used to euthanize stranded or trapped whales.

<br>

Should you have any questions, please contact the Statistics and Modelling Department of the Secretariat at [statistics@iwc.int](mailto:statistics@iwc.int).

<br>
